official_data: Tourism data verified by DIRCETUR / MINCETUR
footer_tagline: Arequipa Tourism: Fragmented → Accessible. Digital platform for centralizing official tourism data for the Arequipa region, Peru.
problem_title_highlight: Visitors only get to see a fraction of it.
problem_description: The region's tourism offering is scattered across agencies that do not share data, and most visitors stay within a few blocks of the historic centre.
problem_quote: Visitors feel they saw Arequipa in a day because they only found what was in plain sight.
about_project_description: TAFA brings together the inventories of MINCETUR, DIRCETUR Arequipa, AUTOCOLCA and INEI into one verifiable, accessible platform, built on open data and with visitor privacy safeguards.
